info.name: Insights.Api Balancing Mechanism Dynamic Generation Forecast API

params.name: level
params.description:
The filter level for the forecast. This can be one of the following:
- `total`: the total forecast for the given time period.
- `bmUnit`: the forecast for each specified BM unit.
- `fuelType`: the forecast aggregated, and optionally filtered by fuel type.

params.name: bmUnit
params.description:
The BM units to query. Add each unit separately. Either the Elexon ID (Eg: `T_CARR-1`) or National Grid ID (Eg: `CARR-1`) can be used.
Between 1 and 10 units should be queried when using the `bmUnit` level.

params.name: fuelType
params.description: The fuel type to query when using the `fuelType` level. Add each fuel type separately. If no fuel types are supplied, all fuel types will be returned.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides the latest wind generation forecast data. This provides wind generation forecast for wind farms which are visible to the ESO and have operational metering.
Updated data is published by NGESO up to 8 times a day at 03:30, 05:30, 08:30, 10:30, 12:30, 16:30, 19:30 and 23:30. Results are filtered by a range of DateTime parameters.
